title: Learning from others’ mistakes: Finetuning machine translation models with span-level error annotations

layout.note: One drawing read top to bottom: reference and output sentences, a curved arrow to a token row, weights and loss glyphs aligned under each token, then the span-loss formula with a bracket caption; the error key sits top right and the loss key bottom left.

lesson: Align a token row, a weight row and a row of loss glyphs in shared columns so one annotated sentence shows how each annotation becomes a per-token training signal; box the columns where one span-level loss applies and tie the box to the formula with a leader arrow.
